title: Engine Oil Filter Housing — Cleaning and Element Change
abstract: Cleaning of the oil filter housing and change of the filter element, including the debris examination that decides whether the engine may be released or must be investigated further.

sections.purpose: This task gives the cleaning of the oil filter housing and the change of the filter element at the scheduled interval, and gives the debris examination that must be done on the removed element.
sections.job_setup_note: Do the drain task first. Cleanliness decides the result of this task: a housing cleaned with a shedding cloth will produce debris on the next element and an unnecessary investigation. Use only the lint free wipes and the approved agent. Keep the removed element intact for examination; a torn element cannot be assessed.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm the housing has been drained and the container is in position. 2. Open the housing cover and remove the filter element without tearing it. 3. WARNING: THE HOUSING AND ITS CONTENTS MAY STILL BE HOT. WEAR GLOVES. 4. Put the element in the examination tray and let it drain. 5. Clean the housing bore and the cover face with the approved agent and lint free wipes. 6. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A SHEDDING CLOTH OR A WIRE BRUSH IN THE HOUSING. FIBRES AND BRISTLES WILL APPEAR AS DEBRIS ON THE NEXT ELEMENT. 7. Examine the removed element under good light for metallic particles and record what you find against the debris chart. 8. If particles are found above the chart limit, do not fit a new element; raise the finding and follow the engine debris procedure. 9. Fit the new element and a new cover seal. 10. Close the cover and torque to the value in the fits and clearances table. 11. Replenish the oil to the level in the servicing table. 12. Run the engine at idle for five minutes and do a leak check at the cover joint.
sections.close_out: Confirm the oil level after the run and top up if required. Dispose of the removed element and the drained oil to the local scheme. Record the element change, the debris examination result and the oil quantity added in the aircraft technical log.

safety_precautions: The housing and its contents may still be hot; wear gloves.
Do not fit a new element if debris exceeds the chart limit.
